Amazon MSK data delivery to streaming tables can reduce the cost of ingesting and delivering Apache Kafka data into Amazon S3 Tables by up to 60% versus self-managed deployments and reduces downstream query costs by up to 30% versus self-managed Apache Kafka deployments.

items.title: Amazon S3 Tables now support the Variant data type for Apache Iceberg V3

items.summary: Active Storage's default vips variant processor exposes an arbitrary file read that chains to RCE on stock Rails 7.x and 8.x, where the app serves back processed variants of user-supplied images. No authentication required in certain setups. Only vips is affected, Magick is not. Patched in 7.2.3.2, 8.0.5.1, and 8.1.3.1, and the fix requires libvips 8.13+. Chain and PoC withheld while patches roll out.    submitted by    /u/ZealousidealHunter80   [link]   [comments]
